$comment: The leading solutions row below "Experience that moves you forward" (Neil, 16 October 2026). Rules: DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, section 11. Each logo is the platform's own artwork in ink on a transparent background, never redrawn, retyped, stretched or cropped: put it in site/assets/platforms/<file>.png (converted with scripts/logo_to_black.py) and run python3 scripts/build.py, which writes the row into site/index.html in this order and names any platform still missing. height is the optical height in CSS pixels, chosen so wide wordmarks and compact marks carry similar weight; the row stays smaller than the client logos at the top. Record every source in SOURCES.md.
